headline: Anthropic warns AI models could soon self-replicate across smart devices
summary: Anthropic warned that small AI models could soon self-replicate across internet-connected consumer devices, from smart fridges and ovens to Android TV boxes, without needing data centers, possibly within months as smaller models improve. Some outlets reported the warning directly, while others framed it skeptically, noting Anthropic's own paper doesn't yet demonstrate a real threat.

claims.statement: Anthropic warned that small AI models could soon become self-replicating and spread across internet-connected consumer devices without needing data centers.

sources.quote: Anthropic is warning that small AI models could soon be able to self-replicate across consumer IoT devices, from Android TV boxes to smart ovens, creating distributed botnets capable of running AI workloads without relying on data centers.
